description: This Java source file defines a Spring Shell component for managing mock light devices, including listing, adding, turning on/off, toggling, and setting light levels.

classes.name: LightDeviceShell
classes.description: Spring Shell component for managing mock light devices, providing commands to list, add, control, and set levels of lights.

classes.name: LightDeviceShell.NameValueProvider
classes.description: Inner class extending DeviceNameProvider to supply device names for MockLight devices.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all mock light devices in a table format.

methods.name: addLight
methods.description: Adds a new mock light device with a specified or default name.

methods.name: turnOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified mock light device.

methods.name: turnOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified mock light device.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the state of a specified mock light device.

methods.name: level
methods.description: Sets the light level of a specified mock light device between 0 and 100.
